lines.japanese:
―――その、足音が消える前に、地面を蹴った。
「来たわね―――――――――！」
　敵意と興奮が入り混じった秋葉の声。
　殺し合いというギリギリの緊張を秋葉は愉しみ、にやりと、俺の姿を視認する。

　その余分さが俺にとってたった一つの有利であり、秋葉にとっての敗因に他ならない。
lines.label: s426
lines.maoEnglish:
―――Before the echo of that footstep can fade, I kick off the floor.
“There you are―――――――――!”
Hostility and exhilaration mingle in Akiha’s voice.
She savors the knife-edge tension of a fight to the death and grins as she catches sight of me.
“―――――――――”
That needless excess is my one advantage—and nothing other than the cause of Akiha’s defeat.

「ダメよ兄さん、いくら速くても近づけば近づくほどはっきりと見えるんだから――――！」
　歓喜するような声。
　秋葉の瞳がはっきりとこちらの姿を捉える。
　そうすれば、あとは簡単だ。
　俺は秋葉に近寄る事さえできず、ここで手足を蒸発させられ、ダルマになって床に転がる。
―――――まあ。
　それも、俺が燃え尽きる最後まで、秋葉が俺の姿を見ていられればの話だが。
lines.label: s426
lines.maoEnglish:
“It’s no use, Brother; however fast you are, the closer you come, the more clearly I can see you――――!”
Her voice rings with delight.
Akiha’s eyes catch me clearly.
After that, it is simple.
Before I can approach, she will vaporize my arms and legs and leave me a limbless Daruma rolling across the floor.
―――――Well.
That assumes Akiha can keep watching me until the last of me burns away.

Akiha’s vacant voice.
The red hair that was burning away my limbs vanishes at once.
Perhaps the corridor’s insistence on a straight line has favored me.
Akiha believed completely that I could only advance straight ahead; she cannot follow me as I use the wall to spring toward the ceiling.

Sensation disappears from one arm and one leg.
They probably no longer exist.
But I have no further need of them.
My body has already acquired the necessary momentum.
Just like that――――
“Ah―――――――!”
I crash into Akiha.

「こ、のォ――――――――！」

ドクドクと血を流す血管ごと、横一文字に線を引いた。
　皮膚も筋肉も動脈も白骨も差別なく、!w1500そこには博愛も憐憫もなく、!w1500百合の華を手折る様に、!w1500諸々の痛みさえ玲瓏と。

lines.maoEnglish:
“You――――――――!”
Akiha raises her face from the floor.
If she sees me clearly at this distance, my body will be vaporized without even a fraction of error.
So.
Before that can happen, I divide her.
Her slender neck. I draw a single horizontal line through it, through the vessels pumping blood.
Skin, muscle, artery, white bone!w1500—without distinction, without charity or pity!w1500; as though plucking a lily!w1500, every pain made crystalline.

　秋葉は犬や猫より低い視点で、薄汚れた壁を見つめている。
　あたりは闇。
こんな風景を眼球に焼き付けて亡くなるなんて、不出来な笑い話のようだ。
「……殺し合いを愉しんでいるようじゃ浅いって、親父は教えてくれなかったのか、秋葉」
　……いや、それは無理な話か。

lines.maoEnglish:
“So that was the last thing you ever saw.”
From a vantage lower than a dog’s or cat’s, Akiha stares at the dirty wall.
Darkness all around. To die with such a scene burned into her eyes is like some poorly made joke.
“Did Father never teach you how naive it is to revel in a fight to the death, Akiha?”
No, that would have been impossible. Makihisa Tohno was naive himself, so no wonder Akiha was so poorly made.

That is why you died.
Here, where no one is.
Alone forever, staring at a wall no one will ever look at, unable even to give a death cry.
“Hah”
Honestly.
My own little sister—how pitiful.
